parts.answer_md: The mean will decrease (by $10\%$). The standard deviation will also decrease (by $10\%$).
parts.working_md:
The mean will decrease (by $10\%$).

The standard deviation will also decrease (by $10\%$).

Explanation why values decrease by $10\%$:

$\mathrm{mean}=\dfrac{\sum 0{,}9x_{i}}{n}=0{,}9\dfrac{\sum x_{i}}{n}=0{,}9\bar{x}$

$\mathrm{SD}=\sqrt{\dfrac{\sum(x_{i}-\bar{x})^{2}}{2}}=\sqrt{\dfrac{\sum(0{,}9x_{i}-0{,}9\bar{x})^{2}}{n}}=\sqrt{\dfrac{0{,}9^{2}\sum(x_{i}-\bar{x})^{2}}{n}}=0{,}9\sqrt{\dfrac{\sum(x_{i}-\bar{x})^{2}}{n}}$
parts.notes: The official explanation of the $10\%$ decrease prints the first standard-deviation formula as $\sqrt{\sum(x_i-\bar{x})^2/2}$; the denominator should be $n$, as in the subsequent expressions.

parts.working_md:
$195^{\circ}$ in $1{,}3$ secs

$\therefore 1$ revolution in $\dfrac{360}{195}\times 1{,}3$ secs $=2{,}4$ secs

$1$ minute $=60$ sec:

$\therefore\dfrac{60}{2{,}4}=25$ revolutions

$\therefore 25$ rev/min
